Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, diagnosis_date, diagnosis_datetime, diagnosis_code, case when length(trim(diagnosis_code)) >= 3 then upper(trim(diagnosis_code)) end as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(diagnosis_code_system)) in ('ICD-10', 'ICD10') order by diagnosis_id, warehouse_identifier

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical diagnosis date. Missing dates produce invalid condition records.
Original diagnosis code, preserved as the source value.
Uppercase, trimmed ICD10 code. Codes shorter than three characters are passed as null to the existing resolver, yielding unknown concept 0 rather than throwing.
